parsed.english: There exist two finitely generated countable discrete groups Γ and Λ, both infinite with every non-identity conjugacy class infinite (ICC), both with Kazhdan's property (T), whose tracial group von Neumann algebras (group factors) are isomorphic, but for which there is no group isomorphism Γ ≃* Λ.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the bespoke IsICC (infinite group with all nontrivial conjugacy classes infinite) and GroupsIsomorphic (no group isomorphism exists), so the ICC and non-isomorphism conditions can be read directly.
